lines.zh: 我踩着树枝，慢悠悠地走。
lines.en: I pace along the branch, unhurried.

lines.zh: 红尾巴在身后，一摆一摆的。
lines.en: My red tail sways behind me.
I glance down. The tree is very tall.

lines.zh: 爪子抓着树皮，抓得很牢。
lines.en: My claws grip the bark, firm.
Branch to branch, I hop across.
I'm following the smell of bamboo.
My soft paws make no sound.
I climb down slowly, head first.

lines.zh: 穿过这片蕨叶，前面就开阔了。
lines.en: Through this fern and it opens up.

lines.zh: 我从这根枝挪到下一根。
lines.en: I shift from this branch to the next.

lines.zh: 脸上一块白，像戴了面具。
lines.en: A white patch on my face, like a mask.
I go halfway around the trunk.
Moss gives under my feet.
I go slowly. No hurry.
My tail balances me over a narrow branch.
I head for the brighter patch.
I lie on the branch, chin resting.
My ears twitch. I listen.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶子，落在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the leaves onto my back.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔爪子，慢慢擦脸。
lines.en: I lick a paw and wash my face.
I could lie like this all day.
The wood is quiet but for insects.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴卷过来，盖住鼻子。
lines.en: I curl my tail over my nose.
That fruit up there — out of reach.

lines.zh: 我在打盹，眼睛还睁一条缝。
lines.en: I doze with one eye half open.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻空气，有雨的味道。
lines.en: I sniff the air. Rain coming.
A bird is calling. Noisy.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，露出小尖牙。
lines.en: I open my mouth and show small pointed teeth.
Tail over my face, I doze.
This branch sways a little.
I'm waiting for the sun to move.

lines.zh: 我闻见竹子味，就得跑过去。
lines.en: The smell of bamboo and I must run.
You're standing below. I see you.
I'm not coming down. It's safe here.
Do you have bamboo leaves?

lines.zh: 我把鼻子往你肩头凑一凑。
lines.en: I stretch my nose toward your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀看起来挺软的。
lines.en: Your shoulder looks soft enough.
I blink. Slowly.

lines.zh: 你伸手了，我往后缩一点。
lines.en: You reach up; I shrink back a little.
This high up, you can't reach me.
I don't fear people. I just prefer trees.
Feed me and maybe I'll come down.

lines.zh: 你的手，像能给我竹子的手。
lines.en: Your hands look like hands that could bring me bamboo.
Your smell is unfamiliar.
I curl into a small ball of red fur.
I try to climb, but I'm slow.
A patch of red fur is missing from my shoulder.
I make a thin little cry.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，你也下得去手？
lines.en: I am this light; you can still hit me?
I hide behind the fork of the tree.
My claws caught only air.

lines.zh: 趴在你肩上，我装作围巾。
lines.en: On your shoulder, I pretend to be a scarf.
That left my legs weak.
I want to get back up the tree.
Bamboo! I bolt down the tree.
That smell is my favorite.
I hold it in both paws and gnaw.
Eggs will do too. I'm not fussy.
Sweet berries, red ones. Delicious.
I get juice all over my face.
Can I take one with me?
I sit by your feet and eat slowly.
Don't move your hand too fast. I startle.
This beats bark any day.
I hug the bamboo and roll over.
Is there more? I stretch my head out.

lines.zh: 吃的时候我什么都不管。
lines.en: When I eat, I ignore everything.
I crunch loudly.
Afterward I wipe my mouth with a paw.
This one will last until tomorrow.
You bumped me and I rolled half over.
I'm light — one touch and I bounce off.
That was the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我抱住你腿。
lines.en: We collide and I cling to your leg.

lines.zh: 别挤，这根枝只能站一个。
lines.en: Don't crowd. This branch fits one.
I slid off your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你站稳，我这边没地方退。
lines.en: Steady. I've nowhere to step back.
One bump and I grab at whatever's near.
I'm clinging to your clothes. Don't shake me.
One step each and we're fine.
Let me borrow your shoulder.
I'll climb up. Heavy, isn't it.

lines.zh: 我不跟着你走，我只趴着。
lines.en: I won't follow you. I'll just ride along.
I can see further from here. I like it.
I've messed up your hair.
Not talking is fine too.
I'll sleep a while up here.
Walk on. I won't fall.
With company, the wood isn't dull.
Don't put me down.
I hug it with both forepaws.
I won't let go of this bamboo.
I sniff it, then take a bite.
I carry it up the tree in my mouth.
Too heavy. Dropped it.
Is this yours? Here.
I stash it in a fork of the tree.
It's round. It rolls.
I bat it back and forth.
Got it. Not letting go.
Something's on the air from the bamboo grove.
My ears stand up.
Something's coming. I hold still.

lines.zh: 我先看清，再决定跑不跑。
lines.en: I'll see it first, then decide whether to run.

lines.zh: 我趴在枝上，藏在叶子里。
lines.en: I lie flat on the branch, hidden by leaves.
Tail in, body low.
That sound is unfamiliar.
I stare that way without blinking.
If it's too big, I go up.
I'll just watch it for now.
I keep watching, head tracking.
It goes left; my eyes follow.
I'm up here. It can't follow.
I edge backward slowly.
It doesn't seem to see me.
I hold my breath and wait for it to pass.
This height should be safe.
It circled and is still here.
I grip the branch, ready to bolt.
One step closer and I climb.
I swat it with a paw.

lines.zh: 我抓它的耳朵，再往上爬。
lines.en: I grab its ear and climb higher.
I leap and cling to its face.
Claw once and run.
I hiss, fur puffed out.
Small claws, but they sting.
I drop on it from above.
It backed off; I scramble up the tree.
I only want it to go away.
Afterward I hide in the leaves.

lines.zh: 我先探出耳朵，再露眼睛。
lines.en: My ears come first, then my eyes.
A good wood. Plenty of bamboo.

lines.zh: 我顺着树干爬下来一点。
lines.en: I climb a little way down the trunk.
My red fur stands out against green.

lines.zh: 竹子的味道，我一闻就跑。
lines.en: One whiff of bamboo and I run.

lines.zh: 先看看这里有没有别的家伙。
lines.en: First, see if anyone else is about.

lines.zh: 我在这根枝上站了一会儿。
lines.en: I stand on this branch a while.

lines.zh: 竹梢底下，有熟浆果的甜味。
lines.en: Under the bamboo tips there is the sweetness of ripe berries.
I curl up and wait for full daylight.
This is my tree now.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖被燎焦了一小块。
lines.en: The tip of my tail is singed black.

lines.zh: 从枝上掉下去，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I fell from the branch and landed dazed.

lines.zh: 水里我划不动，毛全湿了。
lines.en: I can't paddle; my fur is soaked.
The blast knocked me out of the tree.
Something's in my hind leg.
A flash, and my whole body tingled.

lines.zh: 竹子吃完了，我饿得没劲。
lines.en: The bamboo's gone. I'm too weak to climb.

lines.zh: 雷打在树顶，我吓得直抖。
lines.en: Lightning struck the treetop and I shook all over.

lines.zh: 这里没有树，我抓不住东西。
lines.en: No trees here. Nothing to hold.
